notes.title: Deep Inside - is out on RELEASE!
notes.notes:
The work on [b]Deep Inside[/b] is finally finished. And I can say that the game has gone into [b]Release![/b] It's been a labor-intensive two months.

I hope that all of you will enjoy my work!
